description: This Java source file defines a BroadcastReceiver class 'GetRestrictionsReceiver' that manages app restrictions, including creating, populating, and retaining restriction entries, and handling custom restriction activities.

classes.name: GetRestrictionsReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that manages app restrictions, creating and populating restriction entries, and handling custom restriction activities.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming broadcast, initiates restriction creation asynchronously.

methods.name: populateBooleanEntry
methods.description: Initializes a boolean restriction entry with title.

methods.name: populateChoiceEntry

methods.name: populateMultiEntry
methods.description: Initializes a multi-select restriction entry with options.

methods.name: initRestrictions
methods.description: Creates default restriction entries for boolean, choice, and multi-select types.
